table.name: TLGNC_ORDER
table.description: Orders for any type: Bulk/Bag/Special Products, Road/Train/Road-Train. An order consists of header data (in this table) plus n Order-Items (tlgnc_order_item). For Bulk it is typically n=1, but for rail container orders several bulk items are possible, 1 per container on the rail wagon. For special deliveries such as 'Silostellung', there is one special item + 1 material item. For Bag orders, an order can generally contains more than 1 items. The starting point of an order is always a Shippingpoint (maybe an artificial one), and the end point is always a Shipto. An 'order' is the commercial object for a delivery, the 'assignment' is the logistical object for this. For rail, 'orders' are also used for plain transportation to the railway company.

column.name: ORDER_NUMBER
column.description: The order number, used for external systems (output, SAP). Generated independently of ORDER_ID, based on sequence SLGNC_ORDER_NUMBER.

column.name: ORDER_NUMBER_FROM_SEQ_USAGE
column.description: Order number according to the use case specified by 'order_number_seq_usage_cd', based on the configurable sequence counter from table tlngc_conf_seq_counters. Only meaningful if order_number_seq_usage_cd is not empty.

column.name: ORDER_NUMBER_SEQ_USAGE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_seq_usage_bs. Defines the usage/use case based on which the number in field 'order_number_from_seq_usage' is set. The exact step in the workflow when the number is calculated is dependent on the use case, and is hardcoded (in the application) for each seq_usage_cd.

column.name: LDS_DELIVERY_NOTE_NO
column.description: Delivery note number assinged by the LDS (endLoadingRequest/endLoadingPart/affectedOrder/ldsDeliveryNoteNo or endLoadingRequest/ldsDeliveryNoteNo).

column.name: ORDER_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_order_status_bs. Status of the order. 1=new, ..., 6=dispatched, ..., 15=delivered. Comparisons with < and > are forbidden to find out where an order is in the workflow!

column.name: ORDER_CREATION_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_order_creation_type_bs. How the order was generated, 1=Call Center, 2=Web Order, 3=Generated by Logon, 4=Dummy, 5=Pickup Terminal.

column.name: CUSTORDER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_custorder. Reference to the Customer Order on which this Delivery Order may have been created. Since LOGON 2.0 EBM, the terminology Is: 1) the classical LOGON order: Delivery Order 2) the order covering several deliveries: Customer Order. This distinction will become more relevant in AGG business.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_contract. Reference to the contract on which this order is based. Since LOGON 2.0, regular truck orders can only be created based on a valid SAP contract. This field is not required because not all order types (mainly rail/return/repair) are based on a contract.

column.name: SHIPTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Ship-To of this order, i.e. the place/concrete plant/construction site (Warenempfaenger) where the order is delivered to. The shipto is the end point of the order. If the Shipto is of type 'Location not fixed' the actual delivery coordinates/address are stored in the LNF_... attributes of the order.

column.name: SOLDTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Sold-To of this order, i.e. the customer (Auftraggeber) of this order.

column.name: BILLTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The Bill-To this order has to be billed to (Rechnungsempfaenger). The Bill-To is mandatory; if an order is a free-of-charge-delivery, soldto_sap_bp_id must be set for billto_sap_bp_id as well.

column.name: PAYER_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Payer of this order, i.e. on which the credit check is done.

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SAREA. Sales Area for this order. The Sales Organisation (TLGNC_SAREA.sorg_cd) is a part of the sales area identifier, besides distribution channel and division.

column.name: POOL_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_pool. Pool to which an order was assigned for delivery. For truck orders, pools have a geographic meaning. For rail orders we currently distinguish 'standard' and 'narrow' gauge networks as pools.

column.name: COMM_CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. Commercial Carrier (=Commercial Transporteur, Lieferant, Spediteur) who handles the delivery in Logon, and is possibly not the carrier, who is actually transporting the material to the customer. Only possible carriers for this field are carriers flagged commercial, or internal. For rail orders, 'SBB' or 'RhB' are possible carriers. FIXME: reference the new flag internal, commercial, executing.

column.name: EXEC_CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. Executing Carrier (=ExecutingTransporteur, Lieferant, Spediteur) who handles the delivery, possibly not in Logon. This carrier can be a subcontractor, who must have a partner function with the commercial carrier of the order at the time of the transport. Only possible carriers for this field are carriers flagged executing, or internal. For rail orders, 'SBB' or 'RhB' are possible carriers. FIXME: the new flag internal, commercial, executing.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. The shippingpoint where the order can be loaded/has been loaded = the starting point of the order. For rail orders, there may be no explicit 'loading' though, for example for return orders.

column.name: ACTUAL_DEP_RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. The actual railway station from where the wagon departs. Normally this should be the same as shippingpoint.railway_station_id, but the location of the wagon could have been changed independent of an actual Logon order, see wagon.LAST_KNOWN_RAILWAY_STATION_ID and the so-called 'Winterthur-Wuelflingen-case' (ticket ADN47174). The departing station is crucial for the railway company (SBB), and the value is taken from the wagon at the time when the order is sent to the railway company (via SAP). Consequence: Cannot create rail orders before the wagon has arrived at the last destination. This limitation is ok, because transmission to SBB happens only AFTER loading the wagon.

column.name: DELIVERY_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_delivery_type_bs. Delivery type (Lieferart), e.g LKW direkt, Bahn direkt, Bahn-LKW. The value in the order can be overridden over the computed value in the Dispokarte, which is defined by shippingpoint_type_cd of the shippingpoint or (in case of a railway station) of the shipto railwaystation type.

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_DEST_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_distribution_dest_bs. E.g. OUT, INB, IUP, IUD, ... Value depends mainly on tlgnc_shipto_sarea.distribution_dest_cd of the shipto, with some additional logic on return types (relevant for rail orders).

column.name: DELIVERY_FROM_DAT
column.description: Defines the beginning (date and time) of the time frame when the delivery has to happen. For rail orders: Only the day matters, set time=00:00:00.

column.name: DELIVERY_TO_DAT
column.description: Defines the end (date and time) of the time frame when the delivery has to happen. For rail orders: Only the day matters, set time=23:59:59

column.name: ACTUAL_DELIVERY_DAT
column.description: Date and time when the order was actually delivered. When PDA is involved, this date is set based on a PDA event when receiving it. But for Non-PDA orders the delivery date is set eventually by the dispatcher who marks the order as delivered. For Rail orders, this date is set already when creating the order, based on timetable information of the next possible train.

column.name: TRANSPORT_DUR_PLAN_GOOGLE_MIN
column.description: Transport duration from shipping point to ship-to as calculated by Google.

column.name: TRANSPORT_DURATION_MIN
column.description: Planned transport duration from shipping point to ship-to in minutes, i.e. including correction factors truck vs passenger car. See tlgnc_truck_route.time_correction_factor and tlgnc_truck_trip.

column.name: TRANSPORT_DISTANCE_M
column.description: Transport distance from shipping point to ship-to in m. For truck orders, Google Maps is used. For rail orders distance information comes from tlgnc_rail_distance. In the case of carrier stock, when in reality the order is not loaded at the shippingpoint stored on order, but from the carrier stock shippingpoint (stored on the assignment), this field is overwritten with the real distance between the carrier stock shippingpoint and the final delivery place (fix shipto place, or in case of LNF shipto, LNF coordinates). Used for logistics aspects.

column.name: COMMERCIAL_DISTANCE_M
column.description: Transport distance from shipping point of the order to ship-to in m. For truck orders, Google Maps is used. For rail orders distance information comes from tlgnc_rail_distance. This distance is stored when the order gets created, and will never be changed, even if the order is transported from another shippingpoint (for example carrier in stock case). From commercial view SAP is interested in this distance, and this is sent to SAP. For most orders the content of this field corresponds with transport_distance_m, it is only different in case the order was transported from another shippingpoint, and not from the shippingpoint specified when the order was created (stored on order). Used for commercial aspects.

column.name: CUSTOMS_NOTIFICATION_NUMBER
column.description: LOGON EBM 2.x: no longer used. (Customs notification number, relevant only in SAP Order Export Interface. Only needed for deliveries crossing the boundary Austria-Switzerland which involve Parallel. The number is determined by the PL/SQL function findFirstFreeCustomsNotNo, with app.default.order.customs_notification_number.min as the minimal value. TODO: Comment the exact rule (shipping point of plant S131 Loruens, but Shipto in CH I think? More?).)

column.name: DELIVERY_TRSP_ZONE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_trsp_zone_bs. Zone of delivery, used only in SAP Order Export Interface for 'Bag' deliveries and shipto type 'location not fixed', to determine prices in SAP.

column.name: FREIGHT_COST
column.description: Freight cost of the order expressed in the commercial carrier's currency. Calculated when the order is created and recalculated when the order is modified. Will be copied to the preschedule if applicable.

column.name: FREIGHT_COST_CURRENCY_CD
column.description: The current currency of the freight cost. Will be the currency of the commercial carrier once it is set.

column.name: TOLL_FEE
column.description: Toll fee for the truck received from iTrack. As of release 1.12 always in HUF.

column.name: ITRACK_DISTANCE_KM
column.description: Calculated as indexkilometer of truck at the time of Unloading - indexkilometer of truck at the time of Loading (received from iTrack

column.name: DELIVERYNOTE_SIGNATURE_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_signature. Signature given by the recipient of this delivery. The signature and the name of the person who signed it (see contact_person_signature_txt) is received from the PDA. The signature is stored for the order, not for a certain version of the Delivery Note. If the delivery note has to be regenerated (because of a changed billto or corrected delivered_quantity), the signature may be reused to produce the new version.

column.name: CONTACT_PERSON_TXT
column.description: Contact person of the customer for this order. Typically the 'Besteller', and identical to the person that will sign the delivery note. Value is free text, and can be set either by selecting a contact person from the list (from the Dispokarte, tlgnc_shipto_person) or editing the value directly.

column.name: CONTACT_PERSON_SIGNATURE_TXT
column.description: Contact person of the customer who signed the delivery note (via the PDA). The value contact_person_txt is sent to PDA, and can be modified by the customer there. It is sent back to Logon together with the signature.

column.name: NO_PDA_OR_RAIL_EVENTS_FLAG
column.description: For Truck orders: True, if order was NOT transmitted via PDA to truck driver, which is decided by tlgnc_truck.pda_available_flag at the time when order is dispatched/transmitted. For Rail orders: True, if the rail-company for this order will NOT send arrival/departure events. If the order was finally manually set to 'delivered' is not reflected by this flag, only the state when transmitting it matters.

column.name: RELEASE_SAP_FLAG
column.description: Whether to release or hold back an order, i.e. sending it to SAP immediately on completion. Reason to hold back: unclear prices, manual verification needed, maybe because of unexpected PDA events. Flag is only editable if tlgnc_shipto_sarea.release_sap_optional_flag is set OR if flag is 0 (it is always possible to finally set to 'Release SAP')

column.name: RAIL_HOLD_BACK_RE_ORDER_FLAG
column.description: 0=Settings of the shipto will define if a return order is going to be created or not (See tlgnc_shipto.RAIL_HOLD_BACK_RE_ORDER_FLAG, 1=even if the shipto has RAIL_HOLD_BACK_RE_ORDER_FLAG off, the return order must not be created. By default this is false, and will be set back to false after each check. This flag prevents sending automatically a wagon in case it is scrapped.

column.name: FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG
column.description: Defines if order is free of charge for the Customer. Flag is settable to 1 if tlgnc_shipto_sarea.FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG is 1. By default it gets the value of tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG (which also depends on tlgnc_shipto_sarea.FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG), but can be removed manually in order taking.

column.name: SAP_SUPPRESS_MIN_CHARGE_FLAG
column.description: In SAP the customer has to pay a special charge/penalty if he orders a quantity below a defined quantity. Goal is to reduce deliveries which don't utilize the truck fully. Example: if a customer would order only 5 tons then he has to pay transport costs as if the truck had delivered 20 tons plus 5 tons material costs plus penalty. All those cost calculations are done in SAP. LOGON has only the possibility to provide a flag as indication that NO penalty has to be invoiced by SAP.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADRESSES
column.description: E-mail addresses (separated by comma) to be used for order confirmation note and/or delivery note (BB and LS checkboxes in the German user interface).

column.name: ORDER_CONF_FAX_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER
column.description: Fax number to be used for order confirmation note and/or delivery note (BB and LS checkboxes in the German user interface). Enter as +41 44 123456, i.e. country code mandatory and only space allowed for grouping.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_SMS_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by SMS should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER
column.description: Phone number to be used for order confirmation note (BB checkbox in the German user interface. Delivery note by SMS is not supported). Enter as +41 44 123456, i.e. country code mandatory and only space allowed for grouping.

column.name: LOAD_CONF_EMAIL_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES.

column.name: LOAD_CONF_FAX_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER.

column.name: LOAD_CONF_SMS_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by SMS should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER.

column.name: DELIVNOTE_EMAIL_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a delivery note (Lieferschein) by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES. The flag has an effect during order status set to finished.

column.name: DELIVNOTE_FAX_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a delivery note by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER. The flag has an effect during order status set to finished.

column.name: DELIVNOTE_SINGLE_PAPER_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a delivery note (Lieferschein) on paper should be generated, with the comments contained in order.NOTE_DELIVERY and order_item.ITEM_NOTE_DELIVERY. The flag has an effect during event endLoad. In the case of loading via pickup-terminal application, the function print delivery notes always sets this flag to true, overriding the value from Dispokarte/Order Taking.

column.name: CUST_WEBORDER_NOTE
column.description: Notes from the customer for the order. Value is entered by the customer when creating an order in the web-order interface, and cannot be modified by the Call Center Agent. If the note is relevant for other involved persons (Dispatching, Pool), the relevant bits should be copied into the respective note fields by the agent.

column.name: NOTE_ORDER_MGMT
column.description: Notes for the order management about the ship-to. Not modifiable by Call Center Agent. The initial content is composed of tlgnc_shipto.note_order_mgmt and tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.note_order_mgmt is set at order creation time.

column.name: NOTE_DELIVERY
column.description: Additional text for the delivery note (PDF). The initial content is composed of tlgnc_shipto.note_delivery and tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.note_delivery, set at order creation time and can be modified.

column.name: NOTE_DISPATCHING
column.description: Notes for the Dispatching (Pool/Carrier). The initial content is composed of tlgnc_shipto.note_dispatching and tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.note_dispatching, set at order creation time and can be modified.

column.name: NOTE_TRUCK_DRIVER
column.description: Notes for the Driver. The initial content is composed of tlgnc_shipto.note_truck_driver and tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.note_truck_driver, set at order creation time and can be modified.

column.name: NOTE_RAILWAY_DISP
column.description: Notes for the Railway disposition, but in the UI called 'Spedition'. This is misleading, because the terminal screen for Trucks is called 'Spedition', but has definitely nothing to do with it. Anyway: The initial content is composed of tlgnc_shipto.note_railway_disp and tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.note_railway_disp, set at order creation time and can be modified.

column.name: CARRIER_DELIVERY_NOTE
column.description: Additional text for the delivery note, modified by the Dispatcher: The initial content is set from NOTE_DELIVERY and can be modified. The delivery note PDF will use this value A) when printed/faxed BEFORE the delivery (paper case, no PDA), or B) in the PDA case when the customer does not give a signature (because it may be optional). CUST_DELIVERY_NOTE_COMMENT can only be set together with signing it.

column.name: CARRIER_TRUCK_DRIVER_NOTE
column.description: Notes for the Driver, modified by the Dispatcher: The initial content is set from NOTE_TRUCK_DRIVER and can be modified.

column.name: CARRIER_DISPATCHING_NOTE
column.description: Notes from the Carrier for the Dispatching (Pool/Carrier), modified by the Dispatcher: The initial content set from NOTE_DISPATCHING and can be modified.

column.name: CARRIER_DECLINE_NOTE
column.description: The field is set each time a user clicks on decline order on the scheduling screen. Stores the same message what is 'archived' in tlgnc_bizevent.description. If set, on scheduling screen order list section an exclamation mark in a red circle appears to inform the logged in user that the order had been refused by a carrier. Clicking on the exclamation mark in the red circle resets the field's content, and deletes the note.

column.name: CUST_DELIVERY_NOTE_COMMENT
column.description: Additional text for the delivery note (on paper/fax), modified by the customer (contact_person_signature_txt) when receiving the delivery: The content of CARRIER_DELIVERY_NOTE is sent to the PDA, and can be modified there before the signature is given. The delivery note PDF will use this value when printed/faxed AFTER the delivery (PDA case) under the condition that DELIVERYNOTE_SIGNATURE_ID is set.

column.name: ARCHIVING_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_archiving_status_bs. Status of the order archiving. 1=new, 2=archived, 3=archiving failed, 4=deletable, etc.

column.name: DELIVERED_TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_truck. The truck that was used to deliver the order. This reference is set when the order status changes to 15=delivered. This is necessary because this information can be changed soon afterwards by truck composition changes.

column.name: DELIVERED_TRAILER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_trailer. The trailer that was used to deliver the order. This reference is set when the order status changes to 15=delivered. This is necessary because this information can be changed soon afterwards by truck composition changes.

column.name: DELIVERED_WAGON_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_wagon. The wagon that was used to deliver the order. This reference is set when the order status changes to 15=delivered. This is necessary because this information can be changed soon afterwards by container-wagon composition changes.

column.name: DELIVERED_SIMPLE_VEHICLE_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_simple_vehicle. The simple vehicle that was used to deliver the order. This reference is set when the order status changes to 15=delivered. This is necessary because this information can be changed soon afterwards by vehicle composition changes.

column.name: DELIVERED_DRIVER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_driver. The driver that was involved to deliver the order. This reference is set when the order status changes to 15=delivered. This is necessary because this information can be changed soon afterwards by driver changes/composition changes.

column.name: RESCHEDULING_FLAG
column.description: FIXME ADN48705: Implement + make REQUIRED!. True, if this order was dispatched to a truck/wagon which has already started to execute (another) order. I.e., the truck/wagon was loaded for another order, but a dispatcher had to do reassignments. Orders marked as such are not relevant for statistics and truck_route calculations, because the load/leaving shippingpoint events relate to another order, and the truck may have started to drive in another direction first.

column.name: SENT_SALESDOC_TO_SAP_TS
column.description: For outbound orders this represents the DeliveryDocument interface. For IUD/STPO orders this is the TransferDocument interface. Timestamp when the order's sales document was actually sent to SAP. This is the old SENT_TO_SAP_TS. For the pre-EBM interfaces (CHE, NGE), only this timestamp is used (not SENT_SHIPMENTDOC_TO_SAP_TS). After this (and sending the shipment document), commercial information on the order is considered frozen, corrections must manually be performed in both systems. Exception: credit note process, see return quantity and tlgnc_credit_note.

column.name: SENT_SHIPMENTDOC_TO_SAP_TS
column.description: Timestamp when the order's shipment document was actually sent to SAP. See also SENT_SALESDOC_TO_SAP_TS.

column.name: LNF_COORD_LAT
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': Latitude coordinate of the actual shipping address/location.

column.name: LNF_COORD_LON
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': Longitute coordinate of the actual shipping address/location.

column.name: LNF_SITE_NAME
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': Name of the actual shipping address/location. This field will be set to SITE_NAME in assignment part (address is changeable later, at least in the DB model), but the whole name/address will eventually be concatenated into one block and written onto the delivery note as free text.

column.name: LNF_SITE_STREET_HOUSE_NO
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': Addressinformation for the site: Street and Housenumber. This field will be set to SITE_STREET_HOUSE_NO in assignment part (address is changeable later, at least in the DB model), but the whole name/address will eventually be concatenated into one block and written onto the delivery note as free text.

column.name: LNF_SITE_COUNTRY
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': Addressinformation for the site: Country. This field will be set to SITE_COUNTRY in assignment part (address is changeable later, at least in the DB model), but the whole name/address will eventually be concatenated into one block and written onto the delivery note as free text.

column.name: LNF_SITE_POSTAL_CODE
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': Addressinformation for the site: Postal Code. This field will be set to SITE_POSTAL_CODE in assignment part (address is changeable later, at least in the DB model), but the whole name/address will eventually be concatenated into one block and written onto the delivery note as free text.

column.name: LNF_SITE_CITY
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': Addressinformation for the site: City. This field will be set to SITE_CITY in assignment part (address is changeable later, at least in the DB model), but the whole name/address will eventually be concatenated into one block and written onto the delivery note as free text.

column.name: LNF_SITE_VAT_NO
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': VAT number of the ship-to business partner. This number is sent to SAP, and in certain cases specifying this number is mandatory. See also: tlgns_sap_contract.vat_no_mandatory_flag.

column.name: LNF_TIMEZONE_CD
column.description: If shipto is 'Location not fixed': Timezone for ship-to entity

column.name: ON_HOLD_ORDER_AND_LOCKED_FLAG
column.description: 1=true, if order is a so-called on-hold order and currently 'locked' (German: 'Abrufauftrag'), 0=normal order, or an on-hold order which was unlocked. When set for Truck orders: can be processed until status '6=Dispatched'. When set for Rail orders: can not be transmitted to rail company (but loading/dispatching possible). After those states/actions, the flag is readonly and can not be set again. If true order can be deleted even in status dispatched.

column.name: FORCE_TO_SAP_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, the update_orders cron job will send the order to SAP no matter what is the actual delivery date

column.name: BP_CORRECTED_FLAG
column.description: This flag is set to 1 if the business partner (soldto, shipto, billto, sarea) is modified after the order is in status delivered

column.name: ORDER_VALIDATION_CODE
column.description: Order validation code, set during order creation when the Shippingpoint has Fenics loadingpoints. Printed on the scheduling export and send to Fenics. The code is entered by the driver in Fenics and send in SelectOrderForLoading. Loading is only possible if the entered code matches the one in this field.

column.name: ONE_TIME_SOLDTO_NAME
column.description: If soldto is a 'One time customer': Name of the actual soldto address/location.

column.name: ONE_TIME_SOLDTO_STREET_HOUSENO
column.description: If soldto is a 'One time customer': Name of the actual soldto Street and housenumber.

column.name: ONE_TIME_SOLDTO_CITY
column.description: If soldto is a 'One time customer': Name of the actual soldto City.

column.name: ONE_TIME_SOLDTO_POSTAL_CODE
column.description: If soldto is a 'One time customer': Name of the actual soldto Postal code.

column.name: ONE_TIME_SOLDTO_COUNTRY
column.description: If soldto is a 'One time customer': Name of the actual soldto Country key.

column.name: ONE_TIME_SOLDTO_VAT_NO
column.description: If soldto is a 'One time customer': VAT number of the soldto business partner. This is currently not used anymore, instead it's the LNF_SITE_VAT_NO now, see LOGON-4721.

column.name: SPI_CD
column.description: The keycd of the special processing indicator reference record.

column.name: EXTRA_COST_WAITING_TIME_MIN
column.description: Waiting time, only refunded to carrier.

column.name: EXTRA_COST_1_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_order_extra_cost_bs. Extra cost 1 of the order.

column.name: EXTRA_COST_2_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_order_extra_cost_bs. Extra cost 2 of the order.

column.name: EXTRA_COST_3_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_order_extra_cost_bs. Extra cost 3 of the order.

column.name: EXTRA_COST_4_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_order_extra_cost_bs. Extra cost 4 of the order.

column.name: PLANNED_UNLOADING_TIME_MIN
column.description: Calculated value stored when the order is created. Value is overridable on call center through an input field named unloading time. If not overridden on the call center, the unloading time is coming from app default, or silo unloading time default depending on the type of the materials in the order (cem/agg)

column.name: ETRAN_RETURN
column.description: The ETRAN DN number for empty trips (to send the wagons back to the plant).

column.name: ETRAN_OUTBOUND
